_why: P3262: Athom refuses (processing_failed AggregateError) master uploads whose prepared payload has more drivers than the last accepted one. Observed, unconfirmed by Athom (ticket 157057). scripts/ci/driver-count-ceiling-gate.js compares the prepared payload with lastAccepted: warn on master, fail on stable-v5 and bastien-home. Raise a value only after Athom accepts a build with more drivers (cite the build). With --athom-api the gate reads Athom's public API (testBuild.drivers.length of the last build in Test) and allows apiCount + apiOffset; apiOffset = our payload count minus Athom's count for the same accepted build (Athom lists 2 fewer for master 9.0.1615, 1 fewer for stable #417). Falls back to lastAccepted when the API is unreachable.
